segments.text:
V. 5.
He could do no miracle there—Not conſiſte•tl with his Wiſdom and Goodneſs: It being inconſiſtent with his Wiſdom to work them there, where it could not promote his great End; and with his Goodneſs, ſeeing He well knew his Countrymen would reject whatever Evidence could be given them. And therefore to have given them more Evidence, would only have increaſed their Damnation.
